command: $docs=@('README.md','report.md','docs/AUDIT_HANDOFF.md','docs/P3_AUDIT_HANDOFF.md','docs/P3_TIMING_AUDIT.md','docs/P3_COST_SCOPE.md','docs/WORK_LOG.md'); $missing=@(); $checked=0; foreach($doc in $docs){$absolute=(Resolve-Path $doc).Path; $directory=Split-Path $absolute -Parent; $body=Get-Content -LiteralPath $absolute -Raw; foreach($link in [regex]::Matches($body,'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)')){$target=$link.Groups[1].Value.Trim('<','>').Split('#')[0]; if(-not $target -or $target -match '^(https?://|mailto:)'){continue}; $target=[uri]::UnescapeDataString($target); $checked++; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $target))){$missing += [pscustomobject]@{document=$doc;target=$target}}}}; [ordered]@{status=$(if($missing.Count){'FAIL'}else{'PASS'}); checked_local_links=$checked; missing=$missing} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; if($missing.Count){exit 1}
